name: Mist corridor south
purpose: The compressed way from the lift to the Magma Glass Slide: a warm mist corridor whose bend is lit by a single slot of moving lava behind glass, so the excitement starts before the slide room opens; a quiet door on the left leads to the treatments.

ceiling_profile.note: 3 m basalt barrel: compressed passage before the slide room's 8 m shaft hall.

spurs.note: Door in the north wall; ~3 m threshold through rock to the hall (y 60).

hero.why: Walking from the lobby you face the outside of the bend for 15 m: a narrow slot of thick glass with lava moving behind it, the first orange light since the arrival hall and a promise of the slide room; it glows on the water and the mist.

anchored.why: Threshold into the slide hall at the door head, lit from behind.
Orange glow behind the noren so the end of the straight burns orange.
Low niches on the treatment-door jambs.

Pools: one at the lobby mouth, one before the bend (the slot owns the bend), one each side of the treatment door, one before the slide hall.

water.note: Same -20.05 surface as the lobby side.

sightlines.see: Down the diagonal to the orange lava slot at the bend; niches doubled in the water.
Round the bend: the straight to the slide hall, its noren lit orange from behind.
Coming back from the slide: the lava slot and the lobby drum's warm glow beyond.

concept.match: Corridor mood with a hot end: stepping stones, knee-high mist, ankle niches, and an orange glow (the slide hall) where it ends.

dressing.why: Rocks on the inside of the bend.

mood.palette: amber niches, one orange slot, teal water, black basalt
mood.mist: Knee-high (0.4 m) layer over the whole pool, densest at the walls, thinning over the stones. Lit orange near the slot.

conventions: anchored/hero 'at' = object centre on its floor; facing_deg = bearing of the asset's front (+Y). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: spurs, segments, implied portals, bed_z/top_z, stagger/groups on lights, footprint on still water.
